acts.label: Prologue
acts.desc: A Boston woman takes her dog for a walk and suddenly finds herself in a terrible situation she never anticipated. The strange thing is, it helps her.

acts.label: Act One
acts.desc: Two college friends try to stop Donald Trump’s primary season momentum by convincing New Hampshire voters to vote against everything they care about. Producer Zoe Chace follows along.
acts.title: Haley Mary Pass

acts.label: Act Two
acts.desc: When producer Ike Sriskandarajah tries to sleep-train his baby, a neighbor decides to call the police. Later, Ike thinks, "I can work with that."
acts.title: The Dream Police

acts.label: Act Three
acts.desc: A story by producer Boen Wang about how to get through a summer of bad days.
acts.credits: By Boen Wang; Produced by Lilly Sullivan

songs.t: The Only Way Out Is Through

acts.title: Notes on Cycling
